notes: Curated royalty-free SFX catalogue for HNC League social Reels. Every entry was catalogued from its source category page; BEFORE downloading any file, open sourcePage, verify that individual asset's commercial/social-use permission, then drop the WAV/MP3 into packages/social-video/assets/audio/<file> and flip bundled:true. Production renders prefer bundled files when present and fall back to the deterministic procedural HNC synth otherwise (see src/audio/library.ts + src/audio/mix.ts). Mixkit SFX are under the Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (free for commercial use, no attribution required — verify per asset at https://mixkit.co/license/). Pixabay entries are under the Pixabay Content License (free for commercial use, no attribution required — verify per asset on its Pixabay page). Freesound is NOT used in this catalogue (no CC0 asset individually inspected yet). CC BY-NC assets are rejected by validateAudioManifest and must never be added for promotional content.
